---

Every Mermaid and Graphviz diagram below gets an **Enlarge** button (top-right corner, shown on
hover or keyboard focus). In the viewer: scroll or pinch to zoom, drag to pan, `+` / `−` to
step, `0` to fit, `Esc` to close. Toggle the light/dark switch to see the viewer follow the theme.

## Mermaid flowchart

@fig-request shows a request path through a small service.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-request
%%| fig-cap: "Request path through a small service."
flowchart LR
  client([Client]) --> gw{Gateway}
  gw -->|authenticated| router[Router]
  gw -->|rejected| deny[401]
  router --> handler[Handler]
  handler --> cache[(Cache)]
  handler --> db[(Database)]
  cache --> resp[Response]
  db --> resp
  resp --> log[Audit log] --> queue[Queue]
  queue --> w1[Worker A] & w2[Worker B] --> sink[(Archive)]
```

## Mermaid sequence diagram

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant S as Server
  participant D as Database
  B->>S: GET /items
  S->>D: SELECT * FROM items
  D-->>S: rows
  S-->>B: 200 OK (JSON)
```

## In a tabset

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Class diagram

```{mermaid}
classDiagram
  class Viewer {
    +enlarge(svg)
    +attach(svg)
    +observe(root)
  }
  class Dialog
  Viewer --> Dialog : opens
```

### Dependency graph

```{dot}
digraph deps {
  rankdir=LR;
  node [shape=box, style=rounded];
  "diagram-zoom.lua" -> "diagram-zoom.js";
  "diagram-zoom.lua" -> "diagram-zoom-quarto.js";
  "diagram-zoom.lua" -> "diagram-zoom.css";
  "diagram-zoom-quarto.js" -> "diagram-zoom.js" [label="observe()"];
}
```

:::

## Opting out

Wrap a diagram in a `.no-zoom` div to leave it without a button:

::: {.no-zoom}

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  small --> diagram
```

:::
